name: Android Manifest: No Dangerous Permission (app + merged) & Insets Contract
greenMarker: Android Manifest Permissions & Insets Contracts Verified

mutations.name: a permission the app does not need is declared
mutations.why: Every permission has to be justified in the Data Safety form and in review. One that nothing uses is a review rejection and a privacy claim the app cannot support.

mutations.name: a comment that names a dangerous permission (control)
mutations.why: External audit V11 follow-up. The check was includes() over the raw file, so a comment explaining why CAMERA is not requested failed it. Permissions are now read from <uses-permission> elements with comments removed; an explanation must stay writable.
